description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for decoding and handling Clear Key Encrypted Content Management (ECM) data within the Android media framework, including constants, structures, and function prototypes related to ECM decoding.

methods.name: DecodeECM
methods.description: Decodes a clear key ECM buffer into asset information, content key, and default ECM fields.

methods.name: DecodeECMClearFields
methods.description: Decodes specific fields from the clear portion of an ECM buffer, including asset ID, system ID, and ECM version.
